headline: TikTok bans Musk documentary account
summary: TikTok has banned the social media account for Alex Gibney's new Musk documentary. The ban occurred just before the film's wider release. Distributor Bleecker Street was informed of a "permanent suspension."

headline: Mercedes-AMG’s first ground-up SUV is a 1,150hp electric beast
summary: Mercedes-AMG unveils its first dedicated SUV: the 2028 GT SUV. This electric vehicle boasts over 1,150 horsepower, making it an ultra-fast-charging powerhouse. It builds on the success of the high-performance GT four-door coupe.

headline: Elon Musk settles lawsuits over $1 million voter giveaway
summary: Elon Musk has settled two lawsuits filed by Arizona residents. The lawsuits challenged his 2024 promise of a $1 million daily voter giveaway. Critics questioned the legality and claimed the lottery was fraudulent.

headline: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
summary: Meta has updated its terms after backlash over potential content scraping. The company removed language suggesting it could use content, including news, for AI training. This change aims to address concerns from publishers and users.

headline: Dev Behind Russian Roulette Drinking Game Cancels Steam Demo Plans Following AI Copycat Concerns
summary: The developer of "Drunken Goddess Reflux" canceled its Steam demo. Concerns over potential AI copycats prompted the decision. The game is an anime-themed Russian roulette drinking game.

headline: Battlefield 6 Devs Respond After Players Take Aim at 'Secuty' Typo and Cosmetic With 5 Pistols
summary: Battlefield 6 developers addressed player backlash over recent Season 5 cosmetics. Issues included a "Secuty" typo and a controversial five-pistol cosmetic item. The team responded to community feedback regarding these additions.

headline: James Cameron Congratulates Marvel After Avengers: Endgame Beats Avatar at the Box Office Yet Again
summary: James Cameron congratulated Marvel as "Avengers: Endgame" once again surpassed "Avatar" at the box office. The two blockbusters continue to trade places for highest-grossing film. Cameron shared his praise on social media.

headline: Ben Affleck's Batman Movie Would Have Featured Arkham Asylum-Inspired Deathstroke Fight and DCEU Batgirl, Joe Manganiello Reveals
summary: Joe Manganiello revealed new details about Ben Affleck's canceled Batman movie. The film planned an Arkham Asylum-inspired Deathstroke fight scene. It also intended to feature DCEU's Batgirl character.

headline: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,000 arrested after protests
summary: Over 1,000 arrests were made across France following widespread protests. Cities saw violent clashes, extensive looting, and buildings set ablaze. Disorder erupted amid demonstrations against the cost of living.

headline: Watch: Moment historic French town hall spire collapses in flames amid protests
summary: An historic town hall in Limoges, France, was set on fire during national protests. A video captured the moment its spire dramatically collapsed in flames. The incident highlights the intensity of the ongoing demonstrations.

headline: More NHS staff sacked over attacks victims' records
summary: Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust has fired more staff. The dismissals are over improper access to attack victims' records. A new system will be implemented to enhance record protection.

headline: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank
summary: European diplomats faced an attack by Israeli settlers in the West Bank. The Israeli military condemned the violence. However, the prime minister's office dismissed it as a "smear" campaign.
